purpose: Static verification of the shared Assault puddle mask; supplements the central browser art/performance tests

method.execution: Node VM, 1024×1024 mask; actual source block from assault-ground.js
method.originalFunctions: Original Saltline F1/Ab/fs/SR/Rb/U1 noise, depression generation and CPU bilinear sampler
method.geometry: Original BSP asphalt triangles at ground level outside the warehouse, with actual-map roof rasterization and reused-container shelter bounds from the v7 manifest
method.shaderAnchors: All twelve patch anchors must exist in the original Saltline shader source
method.shelterCheck: Every texel outside pavement or below shelter higher than0.35m must retain the dry R=255 value
method.cpuMaskCheck: At exposed pavement texel centres whose cell index modulo113 is0, compare U1 CPU depth with the same stored R value; tolerance0.000001
method.coverageGuard: Revised standing-water area must remain between70% and115% of the original exposed-mask area

limits: The static CPU check does not compare bicubic GPU interpolation or shader-scale aggregate detail at arbitrary shoreline positions.
Node VM timing is not representative of browser startup or frame performance.
Visual quality and sustained60FPS are evaluated by the separate central browser tests.
